howTheSourceWasRendered.thresholdSensitivityAndADisagreementWith: The dispatch attributes to FIX134 the figures 3,469 lost / 2,830 revealed on Superior-55 page 4 and 4,065 / 3,535 on DC-33 page 4. At a dark threshold of 128 this lane measures 4,938 / 2,345 and 5,078 / 2,500. The counts are threshold-dependent: on a plateau spanning thresholds 96 to 112 this lane measures 3,474 / 2,763 on Superior-55 page 4 and 4,146 / 3,472 on DC-33 page 4, which reproduces the cited Superior-55 figure to within 5 and 67 pixels and the DC-33 figure to within 81 and 63. The direction and the location of every cluster reproduce at every threshold tested (64, 96, 100, 104, 108, 112, 128, 160, 200, 240). The earlier figures were measured at a darker cut than 128; neither set is wrong, and a pixel count published without its threshold is not reproducible.

whatWasWrong.class: ROUTE_IDENTITY — an internal LegalEase machine route trailer printed on a FILING
whatWasWrong.whereOnTheDeliveredPage: packet page 5, which is page 1 of the composed proposed order. pdftotext -bbox-layout over the committed canonical.pdf puts the three trailer lines at yTop 659.0-668.9, 673.5-683.4 and 688.0-697.9, all at x 72.0 — immediately below the 'Composed by LegalEase' disclaimer and immediately above the rule that opens the block ORDER_COURT_BLOCK_NOTICE says on its face is the Court's.
whatWasWrong.howManyPacketPagesCarriedIt: four — packet pages 5, 8, 13 and 14. Page 5 is the filing; 8, 13 and 14 are guidance pages that say on their own face they are not filings.
whatWasWrong.whyItIsADefect: The proposed order is the document the moving party hands a Rhode Island Superior Court justice to sign. These are this factory's own obligation-census keys and they mean nothing to that court. The recorded standard is exact: filings recite statute and rule text only, and the record's own words belong in the guide, labelled as internal record text.
whatWasWrong.whyNoCounterAndNoRasterCouldSeeIt: The nine counters read the field map, and the trailer is not a field. The directional raster runs against the pinned source, which exists only for packet pages 1 to 4; the trailer is on a composed page that has no source page to difference against. The family's own committed reports/completeness-counters.json reads visualDefects 0 for a defect that was on the page. It was found by reading the delivered bytes.

remedy.mechanism: machineRouteTrailerIsInternalRecordText, already implemented on this host at scripts/build-census-v1-ri_decriminalized-set.mjs line 940 and already opted into by the sibling ri_multiple_misdemeanors-set
remedy.notANewMechanism: This lane designed nothing. It read machineRouteTrailer(route, surface), confirmed the surface argument is 'filing' at the single proposed-order call site and 'guidance' at the three guidance call sites, and set the flag.
remedy.onGuidance: the same keys under the label 'INTERNAL RECORD REFERENCE, not part of any filing and nothing a court or a clerk needs. It records which LegalEase route record this packet was built from: ...'
remedy.confirmedOnTheDeliveredBytesNotInTheBuil: pdftotext over the rebuilt canonical.pdf and boundary.pdf finds no occurrence of 'Route:' or 'obligation:unit:RI' on packet page 5 or 6, and exactly one labelled occurrence on each of packet pages 8, 13 and 14. A page-5-and-6 text diff against the committed bytes shows the three trailer lines removed and NOTHING else changed: the Court's findings, GRANTED/DENIED, the relief marks, the further-terms lines, the Justice/Judge signature block, the date of entry and the clerk's certification line are character-identical.

directionalRasterAgainstThePinnedSource.method: 600 dpi grey, poppler pdftoppm, annotations drawn on BOTH sides; dark = grey <= 128; added = dark in the delivered page and not in the source page, removed = dark in the source page and not in the delivered page; added pixels attributed by mask to the write rects and selection boxes this family's own reports/actual-writes.json declares, padded 2pt
directionalRasterAgainstThePinnedSource.scope: packet pages 1-4 only, which are the official Superior-55 slice. Packet pages 5-14 are composed and have no source page to difference against.
directionalRasterAgainstThePinnedSource.removedInkTotal: 0 on every page of both fixtures
directionalRasterAgainstThePinnedSource.addedInkOutsideDeclaredBoxesTotal: 0 on every page of both fixtures
directionalRasterAgainstThePinnedSource.page4IsZeroAndThatIsTheEarlierRepairHold: packet page 4 measures 0 added and 0 removed, which is the FIX134 preserveSourceAuthoredSelectionPaint repair at Superior-55 Group4 still holding after this rebuild. That work was not revisited.
